target: 國立成功大學光復校區建築系館院落 懸鏈・榭 / Sewn Pavilion
scope: Historical complete visible pavilion exterior approximation, not measured reconstruction, panel fabrication data, current survival or print certification. No geometry changed by reviewer.
design_features_read: Identity, topology, dimensions, panel and central-frame thickness fields; large sample arrays not individually audited.
source_viewing: All eleven embedded source images and whole article pages personally inspected in research. At final review reopened daylight image0, opposite night image2, indexed assembly image3 and exploded connector image4; all five frozen final render5 PNGs viewed individually.

view_checks.front: Three-lobed fan arches, six strips per leaf, thin seams, irregular representative perforations and revised narrow plate-bundle feet visible; no former round pedestal.
view_checks.rear: Opposite complete fan and open arch clear; third common foot behind is not a fourth support.
view_checks.elevation: Open passage below shell, three shared feet and curved fan spread retained; no solid infill wall.
view_checks.top: Three six-band leaves, three-way arched central connector and small triangular through-gap retained, not a flat cap or missing connector.
view_checks.left_oblique: Folded fan massing, open arches and perforations through thin shell visible; complete object not cropped.

accepted_features: Three leaves A/B/C with six indexed bands each, sharing three plate-bundle ground feet.
Three-way arched connector with a small triangle gap, supported by explicit assembly/exploded diagrams supplementing occluded photographs.
Open archways, varying band crown heights and fan-like spread, pale daylight wood rather than night lighting or diagram blue.
Representative irregular through-holes and panel/seam articulation; background courtyard excluded.
limitations: Source photographs show stronger individual upper-edge staggering and local flare than this continuous-boundary model. This is accepted only as disclosed overall exterior approximation, not exact folded-panel reconstruction.
Photographic micro-hole clusters are omitted; hole positions, counts and shapes are representative rather than measured.

All millimeter dimensions, exact curves, three-way connector surface, triangle-gap size, seam and foot details are estimated. 0.95 mm panels/frame and near-foot thickening are model fabrication reinforcement, not source thickness.
2013 is thesis publication year, 2014-04 article issue; image capture and exact construction dates are unknown. Thesis full PDF not obtained after CAPTCHA, and no bypass used.

Courtyard location is independent multi-feature image cross-identification with the officially named department courtyard, then campus classification from departmental history; not a textual plaque proving installation coordinates. Unrealized Rongyuan course proposal is not used as the completed site.
Official courtyard upload date 2025-02-05 is not capture date; absence of the pavilion in that image establishes neither exact removal date nor current survival.
Visual-source PASS is not physical print, support-free, strength, slicer or exhaustive wall-thickness certification. Preserve all thin-layer/overhang warnings.
